the scheduler's evaluateAlbumEvidenceAction resolves the expected bindings from the ledger BEFORE the verdict — the SAME resolution the send path uses, so the d65d811 F3 rights gate re-reads the durable echo AT the verification/heal moment too (a post-delivery revocation dead-letters typed media_rights_not_publishable with zero sends); the routing: complete -> heal; usage_binding_mismatch -> park album_usage_mismatch with the evidence INTACT (the delivery records AND the wrong bindings stay EXACTLY as recorded — never rewritten, zero sends, never auto-resent); unbound_usages -> reconcile the RESOLVED expected bindings then heal (a mismatch can never reach the reconcile, so it can never silently overwrite a wrong binding); missing_ordinals/foreign_destination -> park album_evidence_incomplete; Phase A's failed-row reconcile consumes the SAME action; (R2/F2, the recent-history window held the OLDEST rows) listRecentPublishedHistory ordered published_at ASC and THEN applied LIMIT 512 — after 512 publications every new send fell outside the window and the scheduler's cooldown/mix/layout policy consumed stale data; the consumer contract byte-unchanged, the SELECTION fixed); no index covers published_at (schema 6 — ZERO DDL) and that honest bounded-read boundary is documented; (item 3/F3, the machine never mints a publish clearance) the review's rightsStateFor finding: an official_api origin or official/verified source metadata was promoted to a durable official/attribution_required echo — statuses the publication allowlist ACCEPTS, i.e. a republication permission invented from the source's name;
